title: Blix knowledge hierarchy: goals x depth x domain x archive type

structure.goal_axis: G0用户价值 > G1整体市场研究与AI协作 > G2市场发现/单Mint/跨Mint/机制 > G3 Blix单主体 > G4当前工作；G是目标关系，不等于知识深度
structure.depth_axis: L0治理横贯；L1链上事实；L2市场机制；L3经济主体/库存/行为；L4候选策略；L5执行和风险；L6实证反证横贯；L7单主体AI知识进化；L为知识层，非任务步骤
structure.domain_axis: D01-D12是专业覆盖范围，保留152个原ID和来源；跨域关联不等于强制依赖
structure.storage_axis: foundations / mechanisms / methods / cases / ai / references是原文主存放用途，可被多个领域交叉引用
structure.evidence_axis: 来源/事实/供应商声明/推论/假说/离线测试/实际运行/失效与未知必须分开
structure.conceptual_axis: 同义、相近、上下位和经济身份是不同语义关系；专业关键词连接研究问题但不直接证明链上同控
structure.claim_relation_axis: 具体主张→源版本/交易证据/竞争解释/实现/测试/修订；不得用文档级映射代替逐主张证据
structure.reality_axis: Token、Token Account、Owner、Fee Payer、Pool、库存、Swap与经济主体是不同现实对象和事件
structure.execution_axis: 输入数据→具体代码版本→执行记录→输出/证据/评估；代码存在与运行成功是不同状态
structure.evolution_axis: 反证、新协议、历史回补与模型任务反馈只修订被证据影响的结论、方法和测试，保留原版本

domains.name: Solana 链上基础
domains.scope: 链上交易、账户、指令、程序、Slot与可观测时间；不涉及钱包实控身份或盈亏判断
domains.open_gap: 确认多动作CPI、Token账户Owner、SOL/WSOL和经济净额的跨模块口径

domains.name: Meme 市场生命周期
domains.scope: 发行路径、合约权限、Bonding Curve、迁移、建池和生命周期的技术状态
domains.open_gap: 发行平台、曲线/迁移、多池与阶段判断缺实际对照

domains.name: 市场微观结构
domains.scope: 池子深度、流动性、价格形成、路由、滑点与交易时点的微观结构
domains.open_gap: 池深、报价、可成交性与真实费用不能混为一谈

domains.name: 钱包行为与角色
domains.scope: 基于行为的地址角色候选及时间变化，不推断现实身份
domains.open_gap: 钱包角色/历史/Owner与PnL需跨源核验

domains.name: 资金网络与主体关系
domains.scope: 资金路径、共同出资、枢纽剔除、经济主体聚类与不确定性
domains.open_gap: 直接入金、代付手续费、公共Hub与控制权仍有混淆风险

domains.name: 筹码与市场控制结构
domains.scope: 持有/可流通供应、地址集中度、经济控制候选与转移结构；集中不等于控盘
domains.open_gap: 供应量分母/Pool/Token Account/Owner/可卖库存存在分层缺口

domains.name: 市场行为与时序
domains.scope: 跨币/跨钱包行为序列、市场状态、叙事传播、注意力与信息扩散，不预设盈利方向
domains.open_gap: 6/12小时事件覆盖、断流恢复与跨Mint成员演化未验

domains.name: 交易策略与 Alpha
domains.scope: 跟单、突破、回收、风险过滤等策略的可证伪规则与适用总体；不预设任何钱包结构
domains.open_gap: 历史Alpha假设与长期样本外预测能力未证实

domains.name: 交易执行与风险
domains.scope: 交易权限与可卖性、真实可成交价格、延迟、手续费/冲击/退出、持仓容量与尾部损失
domains.open_gap: 执行价格、滑点/费用/真实退出条件尚需严格区分，当前只读

domains.name: 数据源与工程可靠性
domains.scope: 数据提供者、字段与单位、索引延迟、缺失、采集覆盖率、取样完整性及数据可追溯性
domains.open_gap: 数据来源/时间/缓存/NULL/配额/恢复与云端可靠性未统一验收

domains.name: 实证研究与反证
domains.scope: 任意研究阶段的反证、零假设、基准、数据泄露、样本分组、功效与样本外复验
domains.open_gap: 原始研究观点未通过一致的基准/反例/样本外验证

domains.name: AI 推理与知识进化
domains.scope: Bot 推理与交接、知识冲突、版本/回滚、人工审阅与只读监控发布
domains.open_gap: 按需知识适用与任务自动调用仍未实跑验收

relations.guard: 必须用链上事件确认发币阶段
发行/迁移切换改变流动性与可观测性
交易签名和账户角色需分开
钱包角色需要资金关系与时间证据
共同出资不能单独证明共同控制
集中持仓判断需考虑池子与退出深度
循环资金和重复团队可形成时序假设
观察到周期不等于存在预测能力
控盘结构不等于价格必然上涨
价格达到目标不等于可成交
策略必须在实际时点和成本下测试
数据错误不能记为反证
用净收益和可执行退出定义经济结果
经独立审查的可复算证据才可触发规则升级
AI 提议可产生候选，不能自我批准

guardrails: 六类目录是存放用途，不是全部专业范围或必经研究阶段
原知识的mapped_unverified状态不因迁入、分类为facts或增加关联就自动升级
D10可靠性及D11反证是必要时横贯检查，不是强制全文每次加载
D05共同资金≠共同控制，D06集中度≠操盘，D08策略假说≠净收益
按需选择相关领域与深度，不固定L1-L7顺序、不创建22个Bot
Blix原生代码和历史故障优先用于理解自身能力；第三方资料保留版本与许可
本轮不修改业务代码、不启动交易/签名/支付/云部署/实跑
Old main core cards are historically source-pinned investigation candidates; do not treat source_contract, documented_legacy_method, or unverified_hypothesis as independent real-world validation.
Historical snapshot manifest is a provenance index; its referenced snapshot bodies have NOT been imported into Blix, and source-repository paths in cards remain old-main-relative until adapted.
Do not conflate exploratory anomaly, provisional mechanism naming, and economic-control attribution; deep source review may identify new domains beyond D01–D12.

knowledge_application.purpose: From user intent to current Blix surfaces, most useful original professional knowledge, primary reference product goal, traceable evidence and dynamic revision; additive to existing G0-G4/L0-L7/D01-D12.

goal_types.project_goals: User-owned G0-G4 and V-A..V-F use purposes; the AI may propose revisions but not silently replace them
goal_types.market_actor_goals: Inferred latent incentives of creator, inventory organizer, sniper, arbitrageur, LP, service, community; observable actions are not proof of intention or common controller
goal_types.professional_lenses: Dynamic problem-dependent perspectives: chain forensics, market microstructure, capital/incentives, statistics, execution, reliability; not fixed agents
goal_types.reference_author_goals: Upstream developer's stated user outcome; separate author claim from inspected source, actual run and economic inference

knowledge_application.adaptive_selection_rule: Select only knowledge that changes the current question, evidence discrimination, investigation priority or checkable product outcome. Preserve independent source context, avoid unverified certainty and excessive skepticism; read deeper only when information value justifies it.
knowledge_application.update_rule: When new evidence arrives, revise only affected observation/inference/priority; retain prior source+time and alternatives. A GitHub link/import is not runtime knowledge activation.

goal_families.name: Market participation and opportunity observation
goal_families.user_question: 现在有哪些盘值得重点盯，为什么是现在？
reference_project_goals: Million: Wallet↔Token discovery and missed-signal review
Blix: market surface and paper observation
Why-Solana: structural signal vs executable edge
goal_families.discriminator: Signal available_at vs actual pool depth, fees, sellable inventory, observed/filtered candidate denominator
goal_families.result: Prioritized read-only watch candidate and explicit promote/demote conditions

goal_families.name: Risk and evidence-weighted token investigation
goal_families.user_question: 这币是不是有人提前安排，证据在哪里？
reference_project_goals: PumpTrace: repeated Creator/wallet behavior, next observations
HoldTech: holder concentration and funding hypotheses
qb-: token account / owner / infrastructure evidence
goal_families.discriminator: Owner vs Token Account vs pool, verified funding transfer vs fee payer, true Swap vs same-slot transfer, temporal coverage
goal_families.result: Evidence-weighted candidate associations, verified events, alternative mechanisms and next signature

goal_families.name: Capital organization, inventory and cross-Mint flows
goal_families.user_question: 转仓的钱包后来谁卖，资金去了哪里？
reference_project_goals: Why-Solana: funding multihop and repeatable mechanisms
goal_families.discriminator: SOL/WSOL and Token balance changes, CPI economic action de-dup, service hub, inventory conservation and actual downstream sale
goal_families.result: Traceable asset path and competing common-control/shared-service explanations

goal_families.name: Whole-market baseline, lifecycle and historical recovery
goal_families.user_question: 现在市场哪些异常在发生，之前漏掉了什么？
reference_project_goals: Pulse: launch-to-death snapshots, selective trade retention and archive
pumpwatch: frozen launch population and normal industrial baseline
goal_families.discriminator: Full opportunity set vs selected saved trades, event_time vs available_at, archival and recovery gaps, survivors vs failures
goal_families.result: Time-stamped market observations, missing coverage and recurrence/false-negative inquiry

goal_families.name: New economic mechanism and falsifiable research
goal_families.user_question: 除了庄家标签，这种行为背后还有什么经济机制？
reference_project_goals: Why-Solana: structural patterns and their regime-dependent loss of edge
meme-: phase, supply, price and failed strategy hypotheses
ai-d: latent unknown and cross-domain mechanism generation
goal_families.discriminator: Which actor goals would produce distinguishable future asset/transaction observations, and what competing mechanism or data bias explains the same signal
goal_families.result: Provisional ranked hypotheses, distinguishing next evidence and change log

goal_families.name: Natural language delegation, validation and evolving product knowledge
goal_families.user_question: 继续项目，选最值得做的事情并保存核验。
reference_project_goals: ai-d: goals, uncertainty origin, research selection, autonomous authorized delivery
PumpGrok: task tickets and safety separation
goal_families.discriminator: Is uncertainty user-only intent, externally checkable fact, knowledge applicability, missing permission or infrastructure failure? Did output actually run and get checked?
goal_families.result: Reversible evidence-based task outcome, readback and localized knowledge correction

rules: Do not treat shared terminology as verified dependency
Do not treat static source index as runtime lineage
Do not treat synthetic CI as live market acceptance
Never infer wallet controller or trading alpha from a conceptual link

cross_axis_alignment.purpose: Connect existing G/L/D/storage/evidence with conceptual, economic, execution and feedback relations without collapsing different evidence identities or creating mandatory pipeline stages.

independentAxes.question: Why and for whom? Whose permission?
independentAxes.mustNotInfer: A model-proposed goal is user authorization

independentAxes.question: Which specialty and competing disciplines matter?
independentAxes.mustNotInfer: Same domain means same type of relationship

independentAxes.question: Is this a documented statement, method, observation, claim or tested output?
Which expressions truly refer to the same thing?
independentAxes.mustNotInfer: Token Account, Owner, Fee Payer and economic controller are identical

independentAxes.question: What exact event, balance, right or mechanism is represented?
independentAxes.mustNotInfer: Any funding/transfer edge proves controller or sale

independentAxes.question: Which source and evidence exactly supports or contradicts which claim?
independentAxes.mustNotInfer: A hash or green CI confirms an economic hypothesis

independentAxes.question: When did it happen, become knowable, become executable, and get revised?
independentAxes.mustNotInfer: New archive visibility implies newly observed live market activity

independentAxes.question: What code and which actual run produced the assertion?
independentAxes.mustNotInfer: Source code present equals deployed and executed

independentAxes.question: What result changes a claim, code behavior or next question?
independentAxes.mustNotInfer: More knowledge entries automatically improve performance

linkKinds.meaning: Synonym, broader/narrower or adjacent term only
Explicit signature + instruction position + owners, asset and time; economic event rather than semantic similarity
Claim derived from an identified source version with an explicit reasoning bridge
Evidence bears on exactly this claim under stated scope/coverage and does not subsume the whole source
A repeatable counterexample or mutually inconsistent source result challenges this claim
Applicability depends on source data, role, fees, provider/time and missing evidence
Specific algorithm, file/commit and input/output contract implements only the stated subset
Which fixture and commit checks which observable outcome
Source selected/available to model with provenance and exclusions
Trace affected conclusion and update only justified scope after review
Keep old claim/version and reason for correction or withdrawal

proofBoundaries.temptation: Common direct funder or same block
proofBoundaries.needs: Exclude shared services; verify direct funding, economic capacity, multiple independent events and control indicators

proofBoundaries.temptation: Token A -> B then B later sold
proofBoundaries.needs: Complete inventory/provenance, verified swap side and time

proofBoundaries.temptation: BigInt raw transfer total or multi-hop sum
proofBoundaries.needs: Token-2022 fees, pool identity, complete holdings and net balance changes

proofBoundaries.temptation: Same address appears for two Mints
proofBoundaries.needs: Asset consideration, transaction path and wallet identity coverage
Model trace and controlled task evaluation
Real archive replay, live read-only verification and independent evaluation
